equipment_shop.data_note: Starting-wealth formulas follow the D&D 3.5 Player's Handbook starting-gold table; item prices, weights, carrying capacities, and size adjustments use the D&D 3.5 SRD under the Open Game License. Item descriptions are original summaries; each item links to its SRD source. The checked-in srd-equipment-inventory.json defines the fixed-price catalog boundary and expected entries.
